line_items.fix: Establish a documented improvement process that includes customer feedback analysis, opportunity identification, prioritization criteria, and action implementation tracking.
line_items.note: No document describes a systematic process for identifying, selecting, and implementing improvement opportunities focused on customer requirements and satisfaction.
line_items.requirement: Determine and select opportunities for improvement and implement necessary actions to meet customer requirements and enhance customer satisfaction

line_items.fix: Create a documented product/service improvement procedure that includes market analysis, customer needs forecasting, and systematic enhancement planning.
line_items.note: No document describes a process for product/service improvement planning that addresses current requirements and anticipates future customer needs.
line_items.requirement: Improve products and services to meet requirements and address future needs and expectations

line_items.fix: Develop a corrective and preventive action procedure that addresses how undesired effects are identified, analyzed, corrected, and prevented.
line_items.note: No document describes a systematic approach to correcting, preventing, or reducing undesired effects in operations or outputs.
line_items.requirement: Correct, prevent, or reduce undesired effects

line_items.fix: Establish a documented continual improvement procedure that defines how QMS performance data is analyzed and translated into improvement actions.
line_items.note: While the management review considers QMS performance, no document describes a systematic process for continually improving QMS effectiveness.
line_items.requirement: Improve QMS performance and effectiveness

line_items.fix: Create a nonconformity control procedure that defines detection, containment, correction, and documentation requirements.
line_items.note: No document describes procedures for identifying, controlling, and correcting nonconformities when they occur.
line_items.requirement: React to nonconformities and take action to control and correct them

line_items.fix: Include consequence management in the nonconformity control procedure, covering customer notification, product disposition, and impact mitigation.
line_items.note: No document describes how the organization addresses the consequences of nonconformities (customer impact, rework, etc.).
line_items.requirement: Deal with the consequences of nonconformities

line_items.fix: Develop a corrective action procedure that includes criteria for determining when root cause analysis and corrective action are required.
line_items.note: No document describes a process for evaluating whether corrective action is needed to prevent recurrence of nonconformities.
line_items.requirement: Evaluate the need for action to eliminate causes of nonconformity so that it does not recur or occur elsewhere

line_items.fix: Create a nonconformity analysis procedure that includes review frequency, analysis methods, and trend identification requirements.
line_items.note: No document describes a systematic process for reviewing and analyzing nonconformities to understand patterns and root causes.
line_items.requirement: Review and analyze nonconformities

line_items.fix: Establish a root cause analysis procedure that defines investigation methods, documentation requirements, and when analysis is required.
line_items.note: No document describes methods or requirements for root cause analysis of nonconformities.
line_items.requirement: Determine causes of nonconformities

line_items.fix: Include horizontal deployment requirements in the corrective action procedure to ensure similar processes are evaluated when nonconformities are found.
line_items.note: No document describes a process for evaluating whether identified nonconformities exist elsewhere or could occur in similar processes.
line_items.requirement: Determine if similar nonconformities exist or could potentially occur

line_items.fix: Develop a corrective action implementation procedure that includes action planning, responsibility assignment, and completion verification.
line_items.note: No document describes requirements for implementing corrective actions to eliminate root causes of nonconformities.
line_items.requirement: Implement any action needed to eliminate causes of nonconformity

line_items.fix: Include effectiveness verification requirements in the corrective action procedure, with defined timeframes and verification methods.
line_items.note: No document describes a process for verifying that corrective actions have been effective in preventing recurrence.
line_items.requirement: Review effectiveness of corrective action taken

line_items.fix: Establish a procedure for periodic review and updating of risk and opportunity assessments, triggered by changes, nonconformities, or management review.
line_items.note: No document describes a process for updating the organization's risk and opportunity assessments based on new information or changes.
line_items.requirement: Update risks and opportunities determined during planning if necessary

line_items.fix: Create a QMS change control procedure that defines how changes are proposed, evaluated, approved, implemented, and communicated.
line_items.note: No document describes a controlled process for making changes to the QMS based on improvement needs or corrective actions.
line_items.requirement: Make changes to the QMS if necessary

line_items.fix: Include risk-based prioritization and action appropriateness criteria in the corrective action procedure.
line_items.note: No document describes criteria or requirements for ensuring corrective actions are proportionate to the severity and impact of nonconformities.
line_items.requirement: Ensure corrective actions are appropriate to the effects of the nonconformities encountered

line_items.fix: Establish documented information requirements for nonconformity and corrective action records, including retention periods and required content.
line_items.note: No document describes record-keeping requirements for nonconformities and corrective actions.
line_items.requirement: Retain documented information as evidence of nature of nonconformities, actions taken, and results of corrective action

line_items.fix: Develop a continual improvement procedure that defines how the organization systematically improves QMS suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness.
line_items.note: While the ISO 9001 certificate confirms a QMS exists, no document describes the organization's approach to continual improvement of the system itself.
line_items.requirement: Continually improve the suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness of the QMS

line_items.fix: Verify the management review process includes a formal mechanism for converting analysis and review outputs into documented improvement opportunities, and create a follow-up tracking system.
line_items.note: Management review minutes exist and likely contain some improvement considerations, but no document describes how analysis results and review outputs are systematically translated into improvement initiatives.
line_items.requirement: Consider results of analysis and evaluation and outputs of management review to determine if there are needs or opportunities for continual improvement
